'''R6-D6''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
R6-D6 was fitted with a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] and worked in [[Uffel Research and Development]] in the city [[X2-4]], on [[Uffel]], as a spokesman.
